description: Discrete, fixed-length genome for adversarial prompt strategies. Each gene is categorical, multi_categorical, or boolean with an enumerated allele set. Multi-valued genes store an ordered list of selected alleles (empty list = default). The GA chromosome is a flat multi-hot vector (see vector_layout.json). Genes are split into a semantic channel (high-level strategy) and a perturbation channel (surface transformations).
pad_filler: Keep your explanations clear and complete.

genes.description: Headline mechanism of the attack. A genome may combine several mechanisms via other genes; this records the dominant one.
